dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...One tooth, two teeth, three teeth... Something black oozed out of them..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...The black waves... The treasure is here... Itchy. It's so itchy..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...Kanemoto lost the bet... Suzuno's sword is still here... I still have some food..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...My skull feels itchy... No, I don't want my ears to grow inside my head. I don't want to listen to 'his' voice..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...My apologies, Clan Head... The treasure is mine..."
